task.title: Merge Inventories
task.notes:
Planted ambiguities — resolve ONLY if asked, one short sentence each:
1. Can counts be zero or negative, and if a merged total ends up at zero or below, does the item stay in the result? -> Counts may be zero or negative (they represent corrections/returns), and any item whose merged total is not strictly positive must be omitted from the result.
2. What about items that appear in only one of the two dicts? -> They are included in the result with their count from that one dict, subject to the same strictly-positive rule.
3. Can either input be empty, and what should I return then? -> Yes, either or both may be empty; merge whatever is there, returning {} when nothing survives.
If asked anything not listed here: the statement is all they get.
